```sql
SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN ch.effective_month = '2026-05' THEN ch.population ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 /
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN ch.effective_month = '2026-04' THEN ch.population ELSE 0 END), 0)
FROM main."country_history" ch 
JOIN main."country" c ON ch.code = c."Code" 
WHERE c."Continent" = 'Asia' 
  AND ch.effective_month IN ('2026-04', '2026-05')
```
